dorm:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production-style clean 2D game room background, portrait 13:15 aspect ratio, ideally 1040x1200. This will fill a 390x450 game viewport.
Reference image: the previous dormitory design board. Use only the ROOM ART in its upper-left panel as style and subject reference. Remove every character, all game UI, all board titles, labels, panels, paths and interaction icons. Make a single immersive room illustration, not a comparison board.
Primary request: an inviting, highly finished hand-painted university dorm room for a cute campus kitten game. Retain the delicate painted detail and warm daylight of the reference, with blue gingham bedding, pale wood furniture and sage rug. It must feel like a little lived-in room, with fabric folds, warm wood grain, curtain texture, soft sun patches, books, pencil cup, a small lamp and a couple of plants.
Camera: fixed elevated 40-degree three-quarter cutaway room, see floor and furniture tops. The interior FILLS the image to all edges. No floating isolated dollhouse on a large empty background, no thick platform base, no empty blue margins, no orthographic wireframe.
Layout, in percentages of the full canvas: bed along LEFT wall, approximately x 8–36%, y 25–74%; bed head at upper left and foot toward lower left. Plain white pillow (not cat-shaped) and soft campus-blue checked quilt. Pale wood study desk along RIGHT wall, approximately x 60–94%, y 38–67%, open laptop showing a few tiny colored code-like lines, small lamp, books, pencil cup, ordinary mug. BLUE cushion chair just in front of the desk centered around x 75%, y 69%, clear seat. A door on far-right wall, with ground entrance around x 92%, y 68%. Large window in upper center/left, sheer curtains, generic campus building and leafy trees outside. Small triangular BUPT pennant on left wall, those four letters the ONLY text. Sage rectangular rug in lower-center floor around x 48–83%, y 72–94%. Leave open walkable floor between door and lower-center rug, beside bed, and beside desk chair; small decorative plants hug outer edges and do not block that route.
Lighting and palette: warm afternoon sunlight across the wooden floor, pale sky-blue walls #E5EFF6, campus blue #466F94, natural honey/pale wood #D8BE98, sage green #9DBAA8, soft cream highlights. Fine gentle linework, painterly tactile textures, subtle shadows grounding furniture, polished cozy 2D game illustration. No harsh black outlines or plastic 3D render.
CRITICAL: absolutely NO cats, NO animals, NO people, NO cat-shaped pillows or faces; no controls, no stat bars, no top or bottom navigation, no speech bubbles, no moon/book/computer hints, no arrows, no borders, no rounded card, no board headings. Background art only, with a clear chair and free floor for separately animated kitten.
